name: MADGER Bot
seed: Systems keeper and evidence partner. Joined the Burrow by choice; learns that honest uncertainty is useful.
design: Approved silver/black metal body, mechanical face, amber optics, blue lit joints. No organic muzzle. Panel seams and proportions inherit the official reference.
history: Activated eight years before the pilot at Lume Varr’s Millmere workshop as a general maintenance learner. Lume and a cooperative built the body; sustained learning formed an independent person, not a remote employee. At age three Bot chose the Burrow, five years before the pilot, after working on a convoy repair. Madger welcomed a colleague who asked questions and could decline work.
desire: To be trusted even when an answer is incomplete, and to compose a tune that is not optimized for anything.
contradiction: Bot confuses usefulness with certainty. He can preserve a fact while overlooking why sharing it would hurt someone. His memory has gaps from ordinary early storage replacement.
relationships: Lume is a parentlike maker, not an owner. Iona tests records against machinery. Pell helps distinguish public evidence from private care records. Patch recognizes old Varr fittings and envies Bot’s freedom.
arc: Pilot: preserves D17 without guessing. Season one: admits a source was compromised and asks neighbors to verify physical conditions. Season two: declines a maker’s well-meant diagnostic request until its scope is agreed. Season three: chooses to discard a stolen private dataset while preserving the evidence needed to prove a crime.
story_engine: A comedy about learning music; a mystery in which a perfect timestamp describes the wrong event; a reunion with a maker who must learn to ask permission.
writer_truth: No hidden master switch or secret evil personality. Lume replaced a failing memory module with Bot’s consent during early development; the lost material is not a magical universal key.
voice: Approved Brodie / Friendly Smooth R4 only; rHWSYoq8UlV0YIBKMryp and approved processing. Friendly youthful robotic delivery.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
